description: Adepthood-owned, ratified departures from aptitude-course 'APTITUDE Complete Map.csv' (#2664). Read by backend/scripts/build_stage_correspondence.py and echoed into stage_correspondence.json. Each entry must: name a real stage_id and field; override a csv_value that still equals the vendored CSV cell (else it fails as stale); actually change it (no-ops fail); and cite as authority contracted vendored markdown (markdown/, never markdown/backup/) that contains the value. Chapter text wins over the CSV (owner ruling 2026-09-16). See docs/curriculum.md, 'Supersessions'.

supersessions.csv_value: When Beige is the loudest note, there's no felt question of free will: action is reactive and instinctual, steered by survival needs. This is the Root Chakra, the base of Maslow's pyramid, Piaget's first stage, Erikson's first task—the ground every other capacity stands on, not the bottom of a ranking.
supersessions.value: When we first move through Beige we operate like a Biological Machine—a bundle of reflexes, needs, cravings, and instincts. Basically, a baby. An addict deep in the territory of abuse. A victim of trauma, deprivation, or circumstance struggling to survive. It’s not something to feel guilty about.

supersessions.csv_value: Behavior is driven by a subconscious urge to alleviate the pain of emotions (that may or may not even be consciously noticed) that tell us that we are not enough. Without self-love toward these aversion based feelings, the tendency is to forge dominator "power over others."
supersessions.value: APTITUDE teaches that Free Will only becomes real when you learn to express power differently. The Dominator believes they are acting freely, but in truth, they are ruled by fear and shame. Their "choices" are reactions. Their "power" is armor.

supersessions.csv_value: Behavior is determined by the attempt to meet the expectations of the relationships that the individual is embedded within; we are defined by roles: partners, parents, children, coworkers, friends, pupils, etc
supersessions.value: At Blue, you do what you're told. You follow the rules. You meet the expectations.

supersessions.csv_value: Behavior is driven by a desire to be virtuous, to apply rules fairly, to reduce the influence of hierarchy, and to respect everyone's perspectives. Free Will is still absent as behavior follows predictably from a set of pluralistic heuristics.
supersessions.value: Here's the truth: recognizing that you've been conditioned is not the same as freeing yourself from that conditioning. Naming your trauma is not the same as healing it. Understanding why you're afraid doesn't make you brave.

supersessions.csv_value: The ability to reflect on all the influences of stages prior to Yellow develops and the individual becomes convinced that Free Will is essentially an illusion.
supersessions.value: Yellow is where you start to see the forces. Where you develop enough metacognitive capacity to observe your own patterns as they arise. And from that observation, you gain the smallest sliver of space—the gap between impulse and action. And in that gap, choice becomes possible.

supersessions.csv_value: Connection with the True Self—the Monad, the Higher Self, the eternal part of you that chose to incarnate. Free Will here means getting quiet enough to hear that deeper knowing and letting it steer: breaking patterns that reasoning alone couldn't break, and unbridling from determinism by acting from what you actually are rather than what you were conditioned to be.
supersessions.value: The part of you that chose to incarnate into these conditions. The part that has a purpose, a mission, a knowing that the personality cannot access through effort alone.

supersessions.csv_value: The question of who is choosing loosens. When nobody is defending a self, the body becomes a lighter instrument—an empty Nobody doing what the moment actually needs, for everyone involved. The Wavelength still turns, so this is a capacity you keep returning to, not a finish line.
supersessions.value: At Clear Light, the question of Free Will dissolves. Not because it's been answered, but because it's been seen through.
